categories.main_business_segments: Hanghua Ink Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the chemical raw materials and chemical products manufacturing industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of various inks and specialized resins. Its main product lines include offset printing inks, UV inks, liquid inks, digital printing inks, and functional materials. The company also provides comprehensive printing solutions and services to downstream customers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as LED-UV curing, UV flexo inks with ultra-low migration, and plant-based oil inks with no mineral oil content. It employs continuous and automated production processes, including high-concentration base ink continuous production technology. The firm has developed proprietary resins and color management systems, and actively participates in green design and eco-friendly manufacturing. It also focuses on R&D in functional coatings for applications in new energy, anti-counterfeiting, and electronics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hanghua serves a broad range of customers in the printing industry, including publishers, packaging manufacturers, and commercial printers. Key end markets include high-end packaging for tobacco, alcohol, cosmetics, food, pharmaceuticals, and consumer goods. The company also targets industrial applications such as electronics, new energy, and decorative materials. Its customers include large printing enterprises and distributors across China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with sales and service networks covering major regions including Zhejiang, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and other provinces. It has subsidiaries and branches in multiple cities such as Hangzhou, Guangzhou, Suzhou, Beijing, and Shantou. While domestic sales dominate, the company also exports products internationally, complying with EU and other international standards.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hanghua operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of inks and functional materials used by downstream printing and packaging companies. It sources raw materials such as resins, solvents, and pigments from upstream suppliers and delivers finished ink products and printing solutions to downstream customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in green, digital, and functional printing materials, emphasizing low-VOC, plant-based, and energy-curable inks. R&D efforts focus on LED-UV curing technology, water-based inks, digital inkjet inks, and specialized functional coatings for new energy and anti-counterfeiting applications. It invests heavily in continuous production technology, color management digitalization, and collaborates with academic and industry partners to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Hanghua generates revenue primarily through the sale of printing inks and related functional materials. It employs a mixed sales model with approximately two-thirds of revenue from distributors and one-third from direct sales to key customers. Revenue is recognized at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance. The company also gains income from investment returns and provides value-added digital color management services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hanghua is a leading domestic player in the Chinese ink manufacturing industry, especially prominent in UV ink production where it holds the top market share among key enterprises. It ranks second in overall ink sales among major Chinese ink companies. The company is recognized for its technological innovation, product quality, and brand influence, competing with other domestic and international ink manufacturers focusing on green and functional inks.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hanghua achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.27 billion, representing a 6.75% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 139 million, up 13.17% from the previous year. The company maintains steady asset growth with total assets exceeding RMB 2 billion and equity attributable to shareholders at RMB 1.55 billion. R&D investment accounted for 4.33% of revenue, reflecting a growth in innovation spending.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hanghua emphasizes its commitment to green, low-VOC, and energy-efficient ink products that meet stringent environmental and safety standards, including compliance with EU regulations and national food contact standards. Its products offer superior printing performance, rapid curing, low odor, and high adhesion, catering to high-end packaging and publishing markets. The company differentiates itself through integrated printing solutions, advanced color management software, and continuous innovation in functional materials, supporting customers' digital and sustainable printing transformation.
